essence: That nectar is to be recognized as the destroyer of wrinkles and gray hair.
The attainment removes signs of aging and all diseases.
Applying the tongue at the root of the palate destroys disease.
The tongue must be constantly contracted and kept joined within the mouth.
Fixing the mind in the heart leads to the transcendent unmana state.
